scope: Specified recovery inventory-integrity repair and two actual status integration counterexamples only; prior independent review remains immutable.
method: Inspected current recovery original-array preservation, duplicate rejection, complete pinned-inventory comparison and rights-adapter argument, plus the two authored status fixture tests. No additional tests run by this reviewer.

checks.detail: corpus_artifacts retains all original nonblank JSONL rows; rights_accounting receives this array, not dictionary values.

Repeated artifact IDs or repeated source/commit/path/digest identities fail before any rights accounting. Rights triage additionally rejects duplicate source/commit/path keys, including distinct-digest variants.

Each source inventory matches its release pin; duplicate exact locked identities are rejected. Exact corpus source/commit/path/digest set must equal the union of complete locked inventories, so matching cardinality alone cannot substitute another file.

Duplicate-corpus and same-size foreign-path tests call actual recovery.status with a rooted synthetic fixture and require explicit ValueError. Existing fixture now supplies source acquisition metadata and an empty rights finding queue without manufacturing approvals.
With exact identity equality and duplicates rejected, original corpus row count corresponds to complete locked inventory count; no row is silently removed before policy digest binding.

note: Support is bounded to the specified integration repair. Authentic externally approved policy and substantive legal judgment remain human-required; this document supplies neither.
